rule: Inventory public surfaces by authority and mutation rights before optimizing them. A public association is not ownership; a client property is not a 561 publication; a built carrier is not a deployed carrier.

classes.discoveryPosture: reference implementation; entity collision still observed

classes.mutationPosture: Turntide source writable; public deployment unsettled
classes.discoveryPosture: built semantic surface awaiting public settlement and observation
canonical identity fragmented across platform surfaces

classes.mutationPosture: observe-only under Publication Discovery unless owner explicitly authorizes mutation
classes.discoveryPosture: strong affiliated authority; never treat as 561-owned link inventory

excludedByDefault: third-party properties merely mentioned by 561 publications
repositories and services with no intended public discovery surface
